why: issue 1978. rclrs has no `count_services` (neither edition); rclcpp (Jazzy) does, as `Node::count_services`, and this is that verb on the Rust node, forwarding to `rust:Executor::count_services` like `rust:Node::count_publishers`. The graph's count, not this node's; discovered, never blocking; `Err(Unsupported)` from a backend with no graph, never `Ok(0)`.
